general.sessionRunningText: A session is still running. If you quit, all student devices will be released shortly. Quit anyway?

startserver.title: Session
startserver.intro: Give the session a name (e.g. class and subject) and start it. Students find it in the student app and join with the PIN shown.
startserver.name: Name
startserver.invalidname: Letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore only (max. 40 characters).
startserver.lansessions: Sessions of other teachers on the network
startserver.selectinterfaceinfo: This device has several network connections. Choose the school network.

dashboard.endconfirm: All student devices will be released and disconnected.
dashboard.nostudentshint: Open the student app, enter a name, type PIN {pin} and choose the session.
dashboard.nopermissionhint: macOS: screen recording is not allowed for Next-Class.
dashboard.idlehint: The screen has not changed for this long (mouse pointer and clock do not count).

control.versionmismatch: The student app does not match the teacher app (version {version}).
control.serverexistsLAN: Another teacher already uses this name on the network.

applock.title: Program lock
applock.pickerhint: Ticked = the program may run. System programs (Explorer, Finder, …) and Next-Class are always allowed. Missing a program? Take it over from a student's running programs (☰).
applock.runninghint: Programs with a window on this device. “Allow” adds the program to the allowlist (and stores it as an own program).
applock.confirmkill: All programs not allowed will be closed after a 30 second warning. Allowed: {n} programs.
applock.confirmreport: Programs not allowed will only be reported after 30 seconds, not closed. Allowed: {n} programs.

netlock.title: Internet lock
netlock.endinpast: The end time must be at least one minute in the future.
netlock.confirm: The internet is blocked on all student devices until {time}. The school network stays reachable. The lock ends at this time (+5 min) at the latest, even without a connection to the teacher app.
netlock.capped: Note: a lock lasts 4 hours at most.
netlock.tamperhint: The firewall was changed on this device; Next-Class restored the lock automatically.
netlock.exceptionshint: One per line: license servers, network drives in other networks – as name, IP or network (e.g. 10.10.5.0/24). Cloud services with many changing addresses do not work reliably.

events.title: Events
events.hint: Only for this session, not saved.

coteacher.title: Co-teacher
coteacher.endedtext: The teacher who started the session ended it or removed you.
coteacher.requesttext: {name} ({ip}) wants to co-control this session. Allow?
coteacher.joinhint: Team teaching: join another teacher's session. The teacher code is shown on their dashboard.
coteacher.address: IP of the other teacher app
coteacher.name: Your name
coteacher.waitingtext: The other teacher has to allow your request on their dashboard.

errors.TOO_MANY: Too many open requests – please try again later.

coteacher.tookover: You are now leading the session
coteacher.tookovertext: The host's teacher app was no longer reachable. Your teacher app took over the session; student devices reconnect automatically.
coteacher.takenovertext: While your teacher app was unreachable, a co-teacher took over the session ({by}). You can join again as co-teacher.
